panels.title: Reliability — SLOs, error budgets, postmortems, toil
Error budgets — service level objectives (28 days)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS "Objective", d.description AS "What it means", s.state AS "State",
  round((s.sli*100)::numeric,3) AS "SLI %", round((s.target*100)::numeric,2) AS "Target %",
  round((s.budget_remaining*100)::numeric,1) AS "Budget left %",
  (s.burn->>'1h')::float AS "Burn 1h", (s.burn->>'6h')::float AS "Burn 6h", (s.burn->>'3d')::float AS "Burn 3d", s.total AS "Events"
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (name) * FROM slo_status ORDER BY name, at DESC) s JOIN slo_definitions d USING (name) ORDER BY s.budget_remaining
SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, budget_remaining*100 AS value FROM slo_status WHERE $__timeFilter(at) ORDER BY at
SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, (burn->>'1h')::float AS value FROM slo_status WHERE $__timeFilter(at) ORDER BY at
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM telemetry.events WHERE status='sent' AND channel='C0BMK83BLFJ' AND sent_at > now()-interval '24 hours'
SELECT readiness_pct AS "Ready %", fully_ready AS "Fully ready", components AS "Components" FROM prr_history ORDER BY run_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.created_at AS "Filed", a.kind AS "Type", a.description AS "Action", a.owner AS "Owner", a.queue_id AS "Queue #" FROM postmortem_actions a WHERE a.status='open' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT cause_key AS "Cause", category AS "Kind", count(*) AS "Events", round(sum(minutes_estimate)) AS "Est. minutes" FROM toil_events WHERE human AND at > now()-interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH n AS (SELECT count(*) alive FROM node_status WHERE last_heartbeat > now()-interval '3 minutes'),
s AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='up' AND last_heartbeat > now()-interval '3 minutes') up, count(*) total FROM service_registry),
l AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='up') up, count(*) total FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_name, service_name) status FROM health_checks
      WHERE checked_by='nova_llm_ping' AND checked_at > now()-interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY node_name, service_name, checked_at DESC) t),
i AS (SELECT count(*) open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical') crit FROM telemetry.incidents WHERE status='open'),
r AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='streaming') ok, round(coalesce(max(extract(epoch FROM replay_lag)),0)*1000) lag FROM pg_stat_replication)
SELECT CASE WHEN i.crit > 0 OR r.ok < 3 OR n.alive < 8 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN i.open > 0 OR s.up < s.total OR l.up < l.total OR n.alive < 10 THEN 'DEGRADED' ELSE 'NOMINAL' END
       || '  ·  ' || n.alive || '/10 nodes  ·  ' || s.up || '/' || s.total || ' services  ·  ' || l.up || '/' || l.total || ' LLM  ·  '
       || i.open || ' open incidents, ' || i.crit || ' crit  ·  ' || r.ok || '/3 standbys, lag ' || CASE WHEN r.lag >= 1000 THEN round(r.lag/1000.0,1) || ' s' ELSE r.lag || ' ms' END AS status
FROM n, s, l, i, r
SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles', 'Dy DD Mon  HH24:MI') AS clock

panels.description: node_status rows whose own mesh-agent heartbeat is < 3 min (target 10; no history table, so no sparkline). Was service_registry until 2026-10-06, which only counts nodes with registered services.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "nodes alive" FROM node_status WHERE last_heartbeat > now()-interval '3 minutes'

panels.title: 🛰  nodes alive

panels.description: services whose latest health_check (mac-studio checker, 10-min window) is up; 32 known

targets.rawSql:
SELECT g AS time,
  (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='up') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (service_name) status FROM health_checks h
     WHERE h.checked_by='mac-studio' AND h.checked_at > g - interval '10 minutes' AND h.checked_at <= g ORDER BY service_name, checked_at DESC) x) AS "services up"
FROM (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '5 minutes') UNION SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz) s(g) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 🧩  services up

panels.description: nova_llm_ping: node/backend pairs up per 15-min round (10 known)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(checked_at,'15m'), count(DISTINCT node_name||service_name) FILTER (WHERE status='up') AS "LLM healthy"
FROM health_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND checked_by='nova_llm_ping' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 🧠  LLM backends healthy

targets.rawSql:
SELECT g AS time, (SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.incidents i WHERE i.opened_at <= g AND (i.resolved_at IS NULL OR i.resolved_at > g)) AS "open incidents"
FROM (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '10 minutes') UNION SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz) s(g) ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'2m'), max(replay_lag_ms) AS "replay lag" FROM telemetry.replication_health WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'5m'), max(value) AS memories FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND metric='memories_total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: node_status (heartbeat age coloured: <2 min good, <10 min warn)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT node_name AS "node", host(node_ip) AS "ip", os_family AS "os", cpu_cores AS "cores", ram_gb AS "ram",
       status, round(extract(epoch FROM now()-last_heartbeat))::int AS "heartbeat",
       round(load_avg_1m::numeric,1) AS "load1", round((load_avg_1m / greatest(cpu_cores,1) * 100)::numeric)::int AS "load",
       round(memory_percent::numeric)::int AS "memory", round(disk_percent::numeric)::int AS "disk"
FROM node_status ORDER BY node_name

panels.title: 🖥  fleet

panels.description: every node that registers services (covers nodes missing from node_status)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT node_name AS "node", count(*) AS "svcs", round(extract(epoch FROM now()-max(last_heartbeat)))::int AS "heartbeat"
FROM service_registry GROUP BY node_name ORDER BY max(last_heartbeat) ASC, node_name

panels.title: 📡  nodes in service registry

targets.rawSql:
SELECT service_name || ' @' || replace(replace(replace(node_name,'nova-',''),'mac-',''),'tv-movies-mini','tvmini') AS name,
       CASE WHEN status <> 'up' THEN -1 ELSE round(extract(epoch FROM now()-last_heartbeat))::int END AS age
FROM service_registry ORDER BY status='up', last_heartbeat ASC, service_name

SELECT checked_at AS time, node_name AS metric, latency_ms AS value
FROM health_checks WHERE checked_by='nova_llm_ping' AND $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_name, service_name) node_name || '  ·  ' || replace(service_name,'llm:','') AS name,
       CASE WHEN status='up' THEN latency_ms ELSE -1 END AS latency
FROM health_checks WHERE checked_by='nova_llm_ping' AND checked_at > now()-interval '6 hours'
ORDER BY node_name, service_name, checked_at DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'10m'), level AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM telemetry.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND level IN ('warning','critical') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 🚨  events per 10 min, 24 h  —  amber warning · red critical

targets.rawSql:
SELECT severity, host, left(title,64) AS title, round(extract(epoch FROM now()-opened_at)/60)::int AS "open"
FROM telemetry.incidents WHERE status='open' ORDER BY severity='critical' DESC, opened_at DESC LIMIT 6

panels.description: pg_stat_replication on the primary (3 standbys expected: .7 .10 .125)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT host(client_addr) AS standby, round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(replay_lag, interval '0'))::numeric*1000,1) AS "replay lag"
FROM pg_stat_replication WHERE state='streaming' ORDER BY client_addr

panels.title: 🐘  standby replay lag

panels.description: scheduler_runs, both schedulers; failure+timeout count per task, top 6

targets.rawSql:
SELECT task_id AS task, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('failure','timeout')) AS "fails 24h"
FROM scheduler_runs WHERE started_at > (extract(epoch FROM now())-86400)*1000
GROUP BY task_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('failure','timeout')) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 6

panels.title: ⏱  scheduler tasks failing (24 h)

panels.description: latest health_checks row per service; one tile per service that is not up

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (service_name, node_name) service_name, node_name, status
  FROM health_checks WHERE checked_at > now()-interval '1 hour' AND checked_by <> 'nova_llm_ping' ORDER BY service_name, node_name, checked_at DESC)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='up') FROM latest) || ' / ' || (SELECT count(*) FROM latest) || ' checks up' AS name,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM latest WHERE status='down') > 0 THEN 0 WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM latest WHERE status<>'up') > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS v
UNION ALL (SELECT service_name, CASE status WHEN 'slow' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END FROM latest WHERE status <> 'up' ORDER BY status, service_name)

panels.title: 💓  health checks (last hour)

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, device_name AS metric, metric_value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'hr_cpu_load_avg' AND device_name IN ($device) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT t.timestamp AS time, t.device_name AS metric, 100.0 * (t.metric_value - a.metric_value) / NULLIF(t.metric_value, 0) AS mem_used_pct FROM snmp_metrics t JOIN snmp_metrics a ON a.device_ip = t.device_ip AND a.timestamp = t.timestamp AND a.metric_name = 'mem_avail_real' WHERE t.metric_name = 'mem_total_real' AND t.device_name IN ($device) AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp) ORDER BY t.timestamp;
SELECT node_name, disk_percent FROM node_status WHERE disk_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY disk_percent DESC;
SELECT node_name, memory_percent FROM node_status WHERE memory_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY memory_percent DESC;

WITH cpu AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name, metric_value v FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name='hr_cpu_load_avg' AND timestamp > now()-interval '1 hour' ORDER BY device_name, timestamp DESC), memt AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name, metric_value v FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name='mem_total_real' AND timestamp > now()-interval '1 hour' ORDER BY device_name, timestamp DESC), mema AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name, metric_value v FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name='mem_avail_real' AND timestamp > now()-interval '1 hour' ORDER BY device_name, timestamp DESC) SELECT cpu.device_name AS "Host", round(cpu.v::numeric,2) AS "CPU Load 1m", round((100.0*(memt.v-mema.v)/NULLIF(memt.v,0))::numeric,1) AS "Mem Used %" FROM cpu LEFT JOIN memt USING(device_name) LEFT JOIN mema USING(device_name) ORDER BY cpu.device_name;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name AS "Device", host(device_ip) AS "IP", round(cpu_load_1m::numeric,2) AS "Load 1m", cpu_cores AS "Cores", round(cpu_headroom_pct::numeric,1) AS "CPU Headroom %", round((mem_used_mb/1024.0)::numeric)::int AS "Mem Used GB", round((mem_total_mb/1024.0)::numeric)::int AS "Mem Total GB", round(mem_headroom_pct::numeric,1) AS "Mem Headroom %", round(disk_worst_pct::numeric,1) AS "Disk Worst %", overall_status AS "Status" FROM capacity_snapshots ORDER BY device_name, ts DESC;
SELECT ts AS time, device_name AS metric, cpu_headroom_pct AS value FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, device_name AS metric, mem_headroom_pct AS value FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, device_name AS metric, disk_worst_pct AS value FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, device_name AS metric, overall_status FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp())::integer, -1) AS "Replica Lag";
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Heartbeating" FROM node_status WHERE last_heartbeat > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 seconds';

SELECT service_name AS "Service", preferred_nodes::text AS "Preferred", failover_to::text AS "Failover To", min_ram_gb AS "Min RAM GB", max_instances AS "Max Instances" FROM service_placement ORDER BY service_name;
SELECT node_name AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM service_registry WHERE status = 'up' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.description: Latest telemetry.backup_runs for the Synology->UNAS job. Green = rc 0, no errors, bytes moved. Red = failed / errored / moved 0 bytes (the silent-green failure).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN ok AND COALESCE(bytes,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status" FROM telemetry.backup_runs WHERE job = 'nova-backup:nas:incremental' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: NAS Backup — Last Run Status

panels.description: Hours since the last NAS backup run. RED if > 25h (a daily backup that did not run).

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(ts))) / 3600.0 AS "Hours Since Last Run" FROM telemetry.backup_runs WHERE job = 'nova-backup:nas:incremental';

panels.title: NAS Backup — Last Run Age

panels.description: Bytes transferred on the most recent run. 0 here = nothing replicated (investigate if unexpected).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(bytes,0) AS "Bytes" FROM telemetry.backup_runs WHERE job = 'nova-backup:nas:incremental' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: NAS Backup — Last Bytes Moved

panels.description: rsync errors on the most recent run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(errors,0) AS "Errors" FROM telemetry.backup_runs WHERE job = 'nova-backup:nas:incremental' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: NAS Backup — Last Errors

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, 'bytes' AS metric, bytes AS value FROM telemetry.backup_runs WHERE job = 'nova-backup:nas:incremental' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: NAS Backup — Bytes Transferred per Run

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, 'files' AS metric, files AS value FROM telemetry.backup_runs WHERE job = 'nova-backup:nas:incremental' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, 'errors' AS metric, errors AS value FROM telemetry.backup_runs WHERE job = 'nova-backup:nas:incremental' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: NAS Backup — Files Transferred & Errors per Run

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "When", rc AS "rc", elapsed_s AS "Elapsed (s)", files AS "Files", bytes AS "Bytes", errors AS "Errors", CASE WHEN ok AND COALESCE(bytes,0) > 0 THEN 'OK' ELSE 'CHECK' END AS "Status" FROM telemetry.backup_runs WHERE job = 'nova-backup:nas:incremental' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 30;

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='up') AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (service_name) service_name,status,latency_ms,checked_at FROM public.health_checks WHERE checked_at>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY service_name, checked_at DESC) s

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'up') AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (service_name) service_name,status,latency_ms,checked_at FROM public.health_checks WHERE checked_at>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY service_name, checked_at DESC) s
SELECT round(100.0*avg(CASE WHEN up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),2) AS value FROM public.sla_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

SELECT round(avg(latency_ms)) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (service_name) service_name,status,latency_ms,checked_at FROM public.health_checks WHERE checked_at>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY service_name, checked_at DESC) s WHERE status='up'

SELECT checked_at AS time, service_name AS metric, latency_ms AS value FROM public.health_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at) AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL AND service_name IN (SELECT service_name FROM public.health_checks WHERE checked_at>now()-interval '1h' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(latency_ms) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 8) ORDER BY checked_at
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'15m') AS time, service AS metric, 100.0*avg(CASE WHEN up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM public.sla_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, service ORDER BY 1

SELECT service_name AS "Service", CASE WHEN status='up' THEN '🟢 up' ELSE '🔴 '||status END AS "Status", latency_ms AS "Latency ms", checked_at AS "Checked" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (service_name) service_name,status,latency_ms,checked_at FROM public.health_checks WHERE checked_at>now()-interval '15 min' ORDER BY service_name, checked_at DESC) s ORDER BY (status='up'), service_name
SELECT service AS metric, round(100.0*avg(CASE WHEN up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) AS value FROM public.sla_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY service ORDER BY value ASC
SELECT value FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='gateway_latency_ms' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='memories_total' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='memories_today' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='ollama_vram_gb' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='pg_size_gb' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='api_cost_today' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, value AS value, 'memories_total' AS metric FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='memories_total' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value AS value, 'gateway_latency_ms' AS metric FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='gateway_latency_ms' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value AS value, 'ingest_rate_per_hour' AS metric FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='ingest_rate_per_hour' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value AS value, 'pg_size_gb' AS metric FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='pg_size_gb' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, value AS value, 'disk_used_gb' AS metric FROM telemetry.nova_meta WHERE metric='disk_used_gb' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT DISTINCT ON (probe) probe AS "Probe", ok AS "OK", latency_ms AS "Latency (ms)", detail AS "Detail", ts AS "Last Run" FROM telemetry.probe_results ORDER BY probe, ts DESC;

SELECT probe AS "Probe", round((100.0 * sum(ok::int) / count(*))::numeric, 2) AS "Uptime %", count(*) AS "Runs", sum((NOT ok)::int) AS "Failures" FROM telemetry.probe_results WHERE ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY probe ORDER BY probe;
SELECT ts AS time, probe AS metric, latency_ms AS value FROM telemetry.probe_results WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS time, ok::int AS "Tunnel" FROM telemetry.probe_results WHERE probe = 'cloudflared_tunnel' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, probe AS metric, sum((NOT ok)::int) AS value FROM telemetry.probe_results WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, probe ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Failures Over Time (count where not ok)

panels.description: One row per Nova component. up dot, RSS, CPU%, uptime, and last-write-age. Rows turn RED when a component is up but not writing data (silent failure).

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY component, instance ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.nova_components WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes') SELECT component AS "Component", up AS "Up", healthy AS "Healthy", rss_mb AS "RSS (MB)", cpu_pct AS "CPU %", uptime_s AS "Uptime (s)", last_write_age_s AS "Last Write Age (s)", note AS "Note" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY healthy ASC, up ASC, component ASC

panels.title: Component Vitals (latest) — SNMP-style device table for Nova herself

panels.description: The #510 detector: daemons that are UP but have stopped (or never started) producing data. Empty = all healthy.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY component, instance ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.nova_components WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes') SELECT component AS "Component", last_write_age_s AS "Last Write Age (s)", note AS "Reason" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND up = 1 AND healthy = 0 ORDER BY last_write_age_s DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: STALE DATA — components up but not writing within SLA (silent failures)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, component AS metric, rss_mb AS value FROM telemetry.nova_components WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND rss_mb IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, component AS metric, cpu_pct AS value FROM telemetry.nova_components WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND cpu_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

WITH latest AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY component, instance ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.nova_components WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes') SELECT sum(up)::int AS "Up", count(*)::int AS "Total" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1

panels.description: Up but not writing data within SLA. Should be 0.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY component, instance ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.nova_components WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes') SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND up = 1 AND healthy = 0

panels.title: Silently-Stale Components

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY component, instance ORDER BY ts DESC) rn FROM telemetry.nova_components WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes') SELECT round(sum(rss_mb)::numeric, 0) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND rss_mb IS NOT NULL
SELECT date_trunc('hour',ts) AS time, decision AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM alert_triage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Alert decisions per hour (page / suppress / downgrade)

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE decision='page')::numeric/NULLIF(count(*),0),1) AS "page %" FROM alert_triage_log WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT count(*) AS "alerts" FROM alert_triage_log WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

SELECT date_trunc('day',ts) AS time, category AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM alert_triage_log WHERE decision='page' AND category IN (SELECT category FROM alert_triage_log WHERE decision='page' GROUP BY category ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 8) AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT source, count(*) AS pages FROM alert_triage_log WHERE decision='page' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY source ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT state AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM freshness_state GROUP BY state ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT stream_name, problem_kind, first_stale_ts, round(last_age_s::numeric,0) AS age_s, last_reason FROM freshness_state WHERE state='stale' ORDER BY first_stale_ts
SELECT state AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM cadence_state GROUP BY state ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT source, kind, state, last_seen, witness FROM cadence_state WHERE state <> 'OK' ORDER BY since
SELECT count(*) AS "open" FROM escalation_state WHERE acked = false
SELECT recurrence_key AS pattern, escalate_count, last_pages, last_escalated_ts, acked FROM escalation_state ORDER BY escalate_count DESC
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, level AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM telemetry.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', ts), level ORDER BY time;
SELECT coalesce(channel, 'unknown') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM telemetry.events WHERE status = 'sent' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM telemetry.events WHERE status IN ('sent','suppressed') AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', ts), status ORDER BY time;
SELECT count(*) AS "Open" FROM telemetry.incidents WHERE status = 'open';
SELECT round((avg(mttr_s) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "MTTR (min)" FROM telemetry.incidents WHERE status = 'resolved' AND mttr_s IS NOT NULL;

SELECT date_trunc('hour', opened_at) AS time, coalesce(severity, 'unknown') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM telemetry.incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(opened_at) GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', opened_at), severity ORDER BY time;
SELECT coalesce(host, 'unknown') AS "Host", count(*) AS "Incidents" FROM telemetry.incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(opened_at) GROUP BY host ORDER BY "Incidents" DESC;
SELECT status AS "Status", tier AS "Tier", count(*) AS "Count" FROM telemetry.remediations WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) GROUP BY status, tier ORDER BY "Count" DESC, status, tier;

SELECT opened_at AS "Opened", status AS "Status", severity AS "Severity", host AS "Host", title AS "Title", member_count AS "Members", round((mtta_s/60.0)::numeric,1) AS "MTTA (min)", round((mttr_s/60.0)::numeric,1) AS "MTTR (min)" FROM telemetry.incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(opened_at) ORDER BY opened_at DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT ts AS "Time", source AS "Source", level AS "Level", category AS "Category", title AS "Title", status AS "Status", channel AS "Channel", dispatch_count AS "Dispatches" FROM telemetry.events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;
